body: # Weekly Market Update: Tech Stocks Lead Market Lower, Basic Materials Gain | Morningstar. *     Stock Market Update for the Trading Week Ended Dec. 12. 3.   Weekly Market Update: Tech Stocks Lead Market Lower, Basic Materials Gain. *   The Morningstar US Market Index fell 0.55%. *   Growth stocks fell 1.12%, blend stocks gained 0.11%, and value stocks rose 1.19%. With investors rotating out of tech stocks, basic materials gained 3.06% and financial services rose 2.38%. This no-moat company with a 4-star rating has decreased 33.1% over the past 12 months. The stock closed the week at $12.15, trading at a 40% discount to its fair value estimate of $14 per share. The 4-star, narrow-moat stock has fallen 32.29% over the last three months and is down 64.13% over the past 12. AmeriCold finished the week at $12.73, trading at a 52% discount to its fair value estimate of $26 per share.

Traders work during the Hawkeye 360 Inc. initial public offering (IPO) at the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) in New York, US, on Thursday, May 7, 2026. The Nasdaq Composite and the S&P 500 fell on Monday, bogged down by declines in technology, as traders monitored oil prices and bond yields while awaiting further developments with the conflict in the Middle East. The broad market benchmark dropped 0.07% to end at 7,403.05, while the tech-heavy Nasdaq slid 0.51% and closed at 26,090.73. Seagate led a selloff in the memory chip space after the CEO said during a JPMorgan conference that new factories would "take too long." Seagate fell nearly 7% and dragged peer Micron Technology lower by almost 6%. The rally in oil prices lost steam after President Donald Trump said in a Truth Social post Monday that he is holding off on an attack on Iran that was planned for Tuesday.
